written: 2026-11-16, before the development panels were run
question: Does a budget-aware handoff from the /2 GP to BiteOpt beat both the GP alone (advanced) and BiteOpt alone (biteopt), and at which share of the budget?

fixed_before_development.guard: handoff_min_populations = 3: hand off only if 3 BiteOpt populations (9 + 3d calls each) remain
fixed_before_development.excluded: ackley: the initial design's centre is its optimum
fixed_before_development.binary: advanced_panel built from the commit that adds the panel arms

arms: legacy (160 only; it allows at most 256 calls)
development.selection_rule: For each fraction f and each (problem, budget), take the larger of the paired geometric loss ratios of handoff-f against advanced and against biteopt. Choose the f whose largest such value over all (problem, budget) is smallest; on a tie, the smaller f (less GP time).

confirmation.success: on the target class, the upper 95% bound of the paired geometric loss ratio of handoff-<chosen> is below 1 against both advanced and biteopt
confirmation.reported_elsewhere: the same ratios on sphere and oscillator, and at 48 calls, where the guard is expected to skip the handoff
